proof_body:
by
  intro f n R₁ R₂ z hd hm hv hz
  have hzb : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₁ := by simpa using hz
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa using hm hzb
  | succ m =>
    have hR : 0 < R₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg _) hz
    have h0mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self hR
    have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := by
      have := hv 0 (Nat.succ_pos m)
      simpa using this
    have ha : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 := hd.analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0mem)
    have hord : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ analyticOrderAt f 0 := (natCast_le_analyticOrderAt_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero ha).mpr hv
    obtain ⟨g, hg, he⟩ := (natCast_le_analyticOrderAt ha).mp hord
    have ho : (fun w => f w - f 0) =o[nhds 0] fun w => ‖w - 0‖ ^ m := by
      have h1 : (fun w : ℂ => w * g w) =o[nhds 0] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
        rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_one_iff]
        have : Filter.Tendsto (fun w : ℂ => w * g w) (nhds 0) (nhds (0 * g 0)) := (continuousAt_id.mul hg.continuousAt)
        simpa using this
      have h2 : (fun w : ℂ => w ^ m) =O[nhds 0] fun w => ‖w‖ ^ m := by
        refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun w => ?_))
        simp
      have h3 := h2.mul_isLittleO h1
      simp only [mul_one] at h3
      have e : (fun w => f w - f 0) =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun x => x ^ m * (x * g x) := by
        filter_upwards [he] with w hw
        rw [hf0, sub_zero, hw, sub_zero, pow_succ, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have h4 := h3.congr' e.symm (Filter.EventuallyEq.refl _ _)
      simpa using h4
    have hm' : Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 R₁) (Metric.closedBall (f 0) R₂) := by rwa [hf0]
    have := Complex.dist_le_mul_div_pow_of_mapsTo_ball_of_isLittleO hd hm' ho hzb
    simpa [hf0, dist_zero_right] using this
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (R₁ R₂ : ℝ) (z : ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R₁) → Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 R₁) (Metric.closedBall 0 R₂) → (∀ k < n, iteratedDeriv k f 0 = 0) → ‖z‖ < R₁ → ‖f z‖ ≤ R₂ * (‖z‖ / R₁) ^ n
